findings.passage: He is a proud Constitutional Conservative who will protect our Second Amendment rights, crack down on illegal immigration and ensure only legal Missouri citizens can vote.
findings.note: Campaign site biography states he will ensure only legal Missouri citizens can vote.

findings.passage: Secretary of State Denny Hoskins is cleaning up Missouri’s voter rolls. His office is conducting a thorough sweep of rolls to remove individuals who are deceased or convicted felons. Additionally, the Secretary of State’s Office is partnering with the Department of Homeland Security and the Federal Bureau of Investigations to investigate any non-citizens who have voted in Missouri.
findings.note: His capitol report newsletter describes the Secretary of State's voter-roll sweep and a non-citizen voting investigation under the heading 'Securing Missouri Elections'. Date taken from the 07-30 in the URL; year inferred from content (Sept 26 2025 event), so month precision.

findings.passage: You will need one of the following forms of identification in order to vote: a nonexpired Missouri driver or non-driver license; a nonexpired military ID, including a veteran’s ID card; a nonexpired United States passport; or another photo ID issues by the United States or the state of Missouri which is either not expired or expired after the date of the most recent general election.
findings.note: Newsletter before the Nov 3 election tells voters which photo IDs are needed at the polls. It informs voters; it does not state his view of the rule.
